title: $12B in customer savings, a major renewable energy milestone and the safety streak continues: 5 takeaways from Lowe’s 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report
summary: $12B in customer savings, a major renewable energy milestone and the safety streak continues: 5 takeaways from Lowe’s 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report
body_markdown:
Safety took another step forward in 2025, with more than 850 fewer injuries for associates and customers, a drop of over 10%.


The lost-time incident rate also improved, marking the seventh consecutive year of safer stores for everyone who walks through the doors.


Five highlights, one year of meaningful progress. From safer stores and new savings at home to


support for


skilled trades and a growing commitment to renewable energy, these milestones reflect progress that extends well beyond the aisles.


[Explore the full Lowe’s 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report.](https://corporate.lowes.com/sites/lowes-corp/files/2026-09/lowes-2025-crr-9-21-26.pdf)
